nodes.text: Professor Doom turns to address the rest of the assembled students.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: We have our volunteers. The rest of you must now divide up and protect the schools from further incursion.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Be brave, my students...
Professor Doom casts an eye toward $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: And be `strong.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And be [color=#e23b3b][i]strong.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: With that, Professor Doom rockets skyward. Headmistress Whitford pumps her mighty butterfly wings and follows after.
All around $SUPERZOE, students are deathly quiet, struck dumb by the weight of what they must now do. Colt snickers.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what are you mopes waiting for, Apocalypse Part Three? Let's do this thing!
A cheer erupts in the crowd, and everyone groups up to do their assigned tasks.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I think Sam is right...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What do we really know about Colt anyway? And if him being with us upsets the students at Spartan Academy, they might try to stop us from completing our mission...
Professor Doom steps forward, rising slightly into the air. A psychic cloud forms above him.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: `No...` Colt `will` join your group...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No...[/i][/color] Colt [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] join your group...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: But why, Professor Doom? I mean, if Colt is going to be disruptive...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: You are new to our school, so you do not know this, $SUPERZOE, but 'team-ups' are often the most effective way of working out differences.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: By joining you today, Colt may prove himself invaluable and also patch things up with Sam. Do you understand?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I guess so, Professor...
Sam looks to Colt and frowns. He beams back at her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, babe. Looks like you're stuck with me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam, but Professor Doom asked for volunteers. If Colt didn't come, then we'd have to `ask` somebody to fill in for him, and that's just not right.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry, Sam, but Professor Doom asked for volunteers. If Colt didn't come, then we'd have to [color=#3b78e2][i]ask[/i][/color] somebody to fill in for him, and that's just not right.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Plus, maybe working together will help you all get past your differences!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, but he... He...
Sam looks to Colt and frowns. He beams back at her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, babe. Looks like you're stuck with me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great...
Professor Doom steps forward, rising slightly into the air.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Be calm, Sam. Your cousin speaks with wisdom beyond her years.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Do not push away those who seek to make amends. Choose to open your arms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is he suggesting that me and Colt hug? Because I'm definitely `not` hugging him.
nodes.text_bbcode: Is he suggesting that me and Colt hug? Because I'm definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] hugging him.

nodes.text: Nearby, adult voices are raised!
$SUPERZOE, Howard, and everyone else turns to see Headmistress Whitford arguing with Professor Doom.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Then what I've heard is true? Viktor von Dyre, Dreadlord of Doomsday, has returned?

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: I'm afraid so...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Then this is a dark day.
Headmistress glances off toward the sea, and the island raised by the tireless efforts of butterflies.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Darker even than I expected.
$SUPERZOE steps forward...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Um, Professor Doom, I'm still kind of new here. Who is Viktor von Dyre?

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Ah... Innocent child, do you recall the lesson from the other day?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I think so...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You said there were four super schools... Centerscore High, Monarch Prep, Wilson High, and Spartan Academy...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: And each one is situated on its own island.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Correct, but there is also something I did not teach you...
Professor Doom waves a hand to indicate the entire assembly of students.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Something that I didn't teach `any` of you. There used to be a `fifth` school. One called the Dyre Conservatory...
nodes.text_bbcode: Something that I didn't teach [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] of you. There used to be a [color=#e23b3b][i]fifth[/i][/color] school. One called the Dyre Conservatory...

nodes.text: A startled murmur passes through the students...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Five is more than four!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Yes, Amanda. This school was overseen by Victor von Dyre.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: He was brilliant, but he also had no patience for education. He believed children took too long to learn, and he hated misbehavior...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: So he perfected a technique for mind control. He called it 're-education'...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: And he used it to transform bright, idealistic students into mindless, subservient drones.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: When Dyre showed the Council of Educators what he'd done, we banished him from Academia.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: We thought we'd seen the last of him, but... But we were wrong, and you've suffered for our error.
Howard leans in, whispering...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, I don't think I've ever seen Professor Doom so upset before. Whoever this von Dyre character is, he must really be bad news.
Professor Doom shakes his head somberly.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: It is imperative that Headmistress Whitford and I travel to the Council of Educators and inform them of what has transpired.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Which means... We must ask even more of all of you.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: While you were rescuing the students of Monarch Prep, Wilson High was attacked and sunk.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What...? Really...?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't know whether to be happy or sad...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: No students were harmed, but the matter remains of grave concern...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Viktor von Dyre has targeted three of the four remaining schools. There is a chance he will strike at the fourth before the day is through...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: I need six volunteers to travel to Spartan Academy and thwart any attempts to sink their island...
Howard immediately steps forward...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can count on me, Professor!
$SUPERZOE steps forward. She takes Howard's hand...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm coming too!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Me three!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Me four is less than five!
Sam steps forward, taking a spot next to $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm not going to let my cousin run into danger without me.
Colt growls and steps forward...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For the record, I'm not volunteering like the rest of these brown-nosers.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've got a score to settle with von Dyre for putting my brain in his blender.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grr... You don't even go to this school, Colt... Or maybe even school `period...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Grr... You don't even go to this school, Colt... Or maybe even school [color=#3b78e2][i]period...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not to mention your history with Spartan Academy...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Remember how much trouble you got into when you crashed Tom Prince's space limo into the sun?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Seriously, guys, do you really think we should let Colt come?
Sam eyes Howard, $SUPERZOE, Hector, and Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's true... We don't know much about Colt other than that he caused a lot of trouble the other day.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, but he's one guy, and it took all of us to bring him down. We might need someone like that if we get into trouble.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I think he's cute!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're cute too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Looks like you're the deciding vote, $SUPERZOE. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I guess I think Colt should...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: We've got superpowers, Howard! Why act like normal people?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I mean, you can fly, and I can go invisible... Put that together, and we could sneak into pretty much anywhere...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Like into a cupcake factory... Or the White House...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Or the top secret cupcake factory in the basement beneath the White House!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow... $SUPERZOE, that's pretty extreme, and it's also how supervillains talk.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: ...It is?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, yeah. You just described using your powers to `break into` the White House to `steal` cupcakes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, yeah. You just described using your powers to [color=#e23b3b][i]break into[/i][/color] the White House to [color=#e23b3b][i]steal[/i][/color] cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh, I guess I got carried away. Having powers is so fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, and that's why it's so important to spend time just acting like ordinary people. It keeps things in perspective.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it can also get a little boring. That's why it's best to do it with someone you care about...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then, if it ever gets too boring, we can just make out!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hee!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah! Pretty much!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ooo... Sounds mysterious! And fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, yeah, just because we've got superpowers doesn't mean we won't need to blend in with regular people.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And it's good to do it with a partner. That way if things get boring, or if you get tempted to use your powers...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We can make out instead!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hee!
The tip of the tidal wave smashes against the hull, showering everyone on board with chilly brackish seawater!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `ECCHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]ECCHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE's boatmates hop down spryly onto the grass.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What a great super rescue!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: According to my calculations, your handling of the boat was less than .502 percent from statistically ideal!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And as much as I'd like to take credit... It's all thanks to $SUPERZOE!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Thanks, guys, but I was just doing what I could to help.
Howard flies over to $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, $SUPERZOE, I saw everything, and you handled yourself really well!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard!
$SUPERZOE taps the ultraviolet button, and a hatch opens up behind her!
There is a sound like a cannon-shot, and a massive sail launches up into the air! The sail unfurls like a parachute and catches an updraft...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Whoa!
There is a sharp jolt, and the entire boat lurches skyward, going up, up, up...
The tidal wave passes just below the hull!
$SUPERZOE peers over the railing. The surface of the water is now many stories below!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: This... This boat can fly?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, yeah... This `super` boat can do a lot of `super` things. Now if you'd be so kind, Captain, please chart a course home.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, yeah... This [color=#e23b3b][i]super[/i][/color] boat can do a lot of [color=#e23b3b][i]super[/i][/color] things. Now if you'd be so kind, Captain, please chart a course home.

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE turns the wheel, angling the sky-boat back to Centerscore High.
All around, other rescue boats take to the air, joining the impromptu sky-bound super-regatta...
Then after a brief wind-powered voyage, the boats all set down on the footbrawl field.
$SUPERZOE presses the wrong button. From deep within the hull comes the sound of massive gears spinning up and grinding together!
Then a tiny hatch opens up in the control panel, and a small television screen emerges. It shows a daytime talk show.

$SUPERZOE spins the wheel, angling the ship straight into the wind, and minimizing the vessel's exposure to the powerful gusts of air!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: There! Prissy, that should keep you from sinking our boat...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Look! We did it! We rescued everybody... Including Headmistress Whitford!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Although... She doesn't look too happy about her island getting sunk.
Denni puts her hand to her temple and reaches out with her telepathic powers.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's the understatement of the year! Her thoughts are buzzing around like a swarm of angry... Well, `butterflies...`

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Uh, it'd be cooler, if the butterflies weren't also creating a hurricane!
The force of the wings flapping creates a powerful gale. Keith points to the turbulent blast of air headed straight toward them!
The blast hits, and the mainsail rips from its line! Keith quickly grips the sail with one super-extendible hand and clamps down onto the mast with the other.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, I've got to hold on. You need to take control of the ship!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: But what can I do?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Just follow the instructions I gave you earlier, and everything will be fine!

$SUPERZOE throws Prissy a life preserver.

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, what are you doing? I asked you to rescue Prissy because your superpowers can negate Prissy's.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So... I should try to make a force field around her?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Exactly... Try it...
$SUPERZOE grits her teeth, make fists of her hands, and mentally projects a transparent force field around Prissy.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I did it... But I still need someone to pull her out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Leave that to me!
Howard swoops down, lifts up the force field with Prissy inside, and then places her in the yacht.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Sorry about this, Prissy, but your Mega Midas Touch is going to make it difficult to rescue you...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: But not to worry. I have a plan!
$SUPERZOE grits her teeth, makes fists of her hands, and mentally projects a transparent force field around Prissy.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Howard, now you can lift Prissy up and put her into the boat without turning into gold!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. Good thinking! And good use of your powers!
Howard swoops down, lifts up the force field with Prissy inside, and then deposits her safely on deck.
$SUPERZOE hesitates...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh, well, I should...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: What are you waiting? I'm not getting any more dry!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh, right...
$SUPERZOE looks around frantically, grabs a life preserver, and throws it to Prissy.
She reaches out, touches it, and instantly, it turns to gold and sinks beneath the choppy waves!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh... That didn't work...
$SUPERZOE tosses Prissy a life vest. She barely has time to strap it on before it too turns into precious metal and pulls her under...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: `Ahhh!!!` What are you trying to do, `drown me?`

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm trying to help. It's just your stupid power is making it impossible. Everything you touch sinks.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: My power isn't stupid! You're just... `Glugg...` Because you... `Gurgle Glugg...`
Howard zips over and inspects the rescue.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, what are you doing? I asked you to rescue Prissy because your superpowers can negate Prissy's.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So... I should try to make a force field around her?

nodes.text: Exactly... Try it...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Leave that to me!
Howard swoops down, lifts up the force field with Prissy inside, and then places her in the yacht.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: We have to help them, Howard. What do we do?
Howard turns back to $SUPERZOE and then the others.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everyone! Listen up! Those of you who can fly need to take to the air and spot students who are in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everybody else, follow after in boats and pull people to safety.
The group murmurs in agreement. In a flash, half of the students have taken to the air.
The others race over to the nearby docks!
Hector transforms into a green-skinned octopus and grabs all eight oars of a four-man racing boat!
Amanda joins him in the coxswain's seat, and together, they zip away!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Row! ...Row!
Colt jumps into a canoe, and immediately it sinks like a stone!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Glgg... Pfft... Too heavy...
Colt scrambles back to the docks and shakes himself dry like a wet dog. Sam looks down from above and giggles...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hee... I knew you were dense! Looks like now we have proof!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's not `me.` It's my metal-infused skeleton that makes me so heavy...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not [color=#e23b3b][i]me.[/i][/color] It's my metal-infused skeleton that makes me so heavy...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you admit you have a thick skull?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's your problem?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, maybe it's because you're not brainwashed anymore, and you `still` haven't told me why you ditched me at that stupid party!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, maybe it's because you're not brainwashed anymore, and you [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] haven't told me why you ditched me at that stupid party!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...It's complicated.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, this `isn't.` See ya!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, this [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't.[/i][/color] See ya!

nodes.text: Sam flares up brightly and then flies off toward the sinking island.
Meanwhile, $SUPERZOE reaches the docks, looking for a boat to board. Keith extends a super-stretchy arm and waves to her from a nearby twenty-foot sail boat.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, over here!
$SUPERZOE climbs aboard, joining Keith and Denni...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay, $SUPERZOE, Denni, do you know how to sail?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, my driving instructor once told me I sailed straight through a stop light.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Right... I'm going to take that as a 'no'.
Keith stretches his arms out like rubber bands, reaching up to the top of the mast and unfurling the mainsail.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: The good news is sailing's pretty simple. There are only two things you need to remember...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: One, if we hit a high wind, let out the sail, and then sail into the wind...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And two, never ever push the shiny, `ultraviolet` button... Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: And two, never ever push the shiny, [color=#e23b3b][i]ultraviolet[/i][/color] button... Got it?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh, maybe...?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That'll have to do...
Keith extends his super-stretchy arms down into the water and raises the quantum anchor by hand!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Let's go!
A few minutes later...
$SUPERZOE and Keith steer the boat to where Monarch Prep used to be. All around, heroes rescue water-logged students.
Howard swoops overhead and points near $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, looks like the boat that just picked up Prissy is in big trouble.
$SUPERZOE looks in the direction Howard's pointing. Prissy is at the stern of a small yacht that is quickly turning into gold!
Taylor, Brendan, and Dexter are huddled at the bow.
As more and more of the boat turns to gold, it sinks deeper into the water.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It's not my fault! I have Mega Midas Touch... Everything I touch turns to gold!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: The only way to control my power is with Element Gloves, but the island sank before I could grab them.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You being sorry doesn't change the fact that we're sinking!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Alert! Getting wet will short circuit my cerebro-circuitry! I don't want to have to relearn supernometry!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I don't want to have to redo my perfect hair!
Their boat gives one last sigh and then disappears beneath the waves! The passengers splash to the surface and tread water.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Uh oh... We better act quickly. $SUPERZOE, you get Prissy. Denni and I will grab the others.
Keith reaches out to Taylor, Brendan, and Dexter, extending his arms until they become two rubbery lifelines. Denni helps reel them in.
At the same time, $SUPERZOE turns to Prissy and...

options.label: Creates a force field around her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Tragic? Trust me... Those rich girls can afford to buy another school. Or another `three` schools.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tragic? Trust me... Those rich girls can afford to buy another school. Or another [color=#3b78e2][i]three[/i][/color] schools.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it does look pretty dangerous, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We should probably go help before they break a nail or drown... Or get eaten by sharks...
$SUPERZOE turns to Howard, gripping his arm.
Howard reaches out and takes your hand.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, it is... And it's okay to be scared, $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Says you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Stuff it, skunk bear! Howard is right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's scary! Not only will it be dangerous, but imagine what will happen if we fail!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it's not just scary because a rescue mission is dangerous. It's scary thinking about what will happen to the Monarch Prep girls if our rescue fails!
Score Up!
$SUPERZOE concentrates, flexing her force field mightily... And `KRRRKKKKK!!!` The cage shatters, spitting sand in all directions!
nodes.text_bbcode: $SUPERZOE concentrates, flexing her force field mightily... And [b]KRRRKKKKK!!![/b] The cage shatters, spitting sand in all directions!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ha! You're going to have to do better than that!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Whu... No! That's so not fair! I am `so` going to...
nodes.text_bbcode: Whu... No! That's so not fair! I am [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] going to...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're going to `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're going to [color=#e23b3b][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE spins around. Howard, Sam, Colt, Hector, and Amanda have recovered and lined up in a row.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So going to `what?` Me and my friends beat you, and we'll beat Principal von Jerkface too!
nodes.text_bbcode: So going to [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color] Me and my friends beat you, and we'll beat Principal von Jerkface too!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: That's Principal von `Dyre` to you, whelp!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's Principal von [i]Dyre[/i] to you, whelp!

nodes.text: As $SUPERZOE concentrates on maintaining her force field, her mind suddenly begins to cloud over with everyday distractions...
Homework, boys, Sam and her relationship with Colt...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh no... I'm getting too distracted! I'm... Starting to... Lose...
$SUPERZOE's force field pops, making a sound like a burst balloon, and the glass spears harden into an impenetrable cage around her.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Got you... You're trapped! Viktor von Dyre is gonna be so psyched when he gets here!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Sand... I make `SAND!` And that's all glass is... Melty sand!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sand... I make [color=#e23b3b][i]SAND![/i][/color] And that's all glass is... Melty sand!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Speaking of... That's why `I` can also do `THIS!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Speaking of... That's why [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] can also do [color=#e23b3b][i]THIS![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chad raises his arms upward like an orchestra conductor motioning for a big crescendo! All around $SUPERZOE, the earth rattles, shakes...
And then a circle of earthen spears punch upward through the turf, completely surrounding $SUPERZOE! The spears harden from sand into translucent glass!
As they do, they move inward, forming a tighter and tighter cage!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh no! Once that sand fully hardens into glass, it'll be too strong to break with my force fields!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I have to act fast!
$SUPERZOE grits her teeth, concentrates, and projects her force field outward...
The glass ball strikes the bowl, curves along the concave bottom, and zips back in the same direction it was tossed!
It strikes Chad square in the face, and his nose bends at a bad angle!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Gff...` I dink doo broke by dose!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gff...[/i][/color] I dink doo broke by dose!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Really?
Chad's facial features turn to sand, rearrange, and then return to normal!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Nah... Just kidding. I'm fine... But that still wasn't very nice.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: For the record, I don't think I'm interested in you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Like I care... Where'd you get that glass ball? I thought your superpower was making dirt or whatever...
The glass ball hits the plate-shaped force field, bounces straight up... And plinks down on $SUPERZOE's forehead!
The glass ball hits the knife-shaped force field, spins it, and continues forward unabated... The ball pings against $SUPERZOE's forehead!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `Oww...` That hurt! How'd you even do that? I thought your superpower was making dirt or whatever...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oww...[/i][/color] That hurt! How'd you even do that? I thought your superpower was making dirt or whatever...

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE hesitates, failing to raise her shield in time! The glass ball slams against her forehead!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `Oww...` That hurt! How'd you even do that? I thought your superpower was making dirt or whatever...
Chad puts his hands together, presses down hard... And when he pulls them apart, he holds a heavy glass ball!
Chad rears back and chucks it like a baseball!
$SUPERZOE concentrates and creates a force field in the shape of a...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Pfft...` Show's what you know! He ran a school, and it was called the Dyre Conservatory!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Pfft...[/i][/color] Show's what you know! He ran a school, and it was called the Dyre Conservatory!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And I'm totally going to be valordict... Er, valurdyre... Um, the guy with the best grades ever!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: And I also know that the Council of Educators banished him for being jerk-tastic!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Okay, so maybe you've `heard` about him! But what difference does it make?
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, so maybe you've [color=#e23b3b][i]heard[/i][/color] about him! But what difference does it make?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I'm totally going to be valordict... Er, valurdyre... Um, the guy with the best grades ever when his conservatory opens back up!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Pfft...` Show's what you know! He ran a school, and it was called the Dyre Conservatory!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And I'm totally going to be valordict... Er, valurdyre... Um, the guy with the best grades ever!
$SUPERZOE freezes up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Umm, uh... He also used to oversee Dyre MacIntyre's Lyre... Dyre-porium?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Pfft...` Show's what you know! He ran a school, and it was called the Dyre Conservatory!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And I'm totally going to be valordict... Er, valurdyre... Um, the guy with the best grades ever!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ow... That hurt!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Good! You totally deserve it! Only a creep would work with Viktor von Dyre!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What do you even know about him?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I know lots! I know that he used to oversee...
$SUPERZOE ducks low, and puts herself right in position for Chad to leap up from below ground and grab her!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Got you!
Chad's fingers claw and tear at $SUPERZOE, pulling her down into the dirt.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Eww! Sandy `and` handsy... Let go!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eww! Sandy [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] handsy... Let go!

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE grimaces, summoning her power, and projects a force field outward in all directions!
Chad explodes into a shower of fine sand! $SUPERZOE scrambles away, and Chad begins to slowly reform...
$SUPERZOE jumps, and Chad passes beneath! He keeps going until he hits a polo goal post head on!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Watch your step!
Chad surfaces, rubbing his aching brow...
$SUPERZOE freezes up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh...
Chad leaps up from below ground and grabs her!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Got you!
Chad's fingers claw and tear at $SUPERZOE, pulling her down into the dirt.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Eww! Sandy `and` handsy... Let go!
$SUPERZOE grimaces, summoning her power, and projects a force field outward in all directions!
Chad explodes into a shower of fine sand! $SUPERZOE scrambles away, and Chad begins to slowly reform...
As Chad says 'spin', he begins to rotate superfast. He drills down into the earth!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh oh...
There is a rumble from underneath, and then across the field the earth bulges up. The bulge begins to move, charging right at $SUPERZOE!
At the very last second, she...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Huh... Pretty smart. How'd you know that I wasn't brainwashed like all the other mindless stooges Viktor von Dyre has been using?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, I couldn't know for sure... But mindless drones don't generally make bad jokes and try to score dates.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: But seeing as you aren't brainwashed, I get to ask you 'why'?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Why are you helping Viktor von Dyre destroy all the super schools?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Easy... Because he promised I'd get straight A's if I went to his `new` school.
nodes.text_bbcode: Easy... Because he promised I'd get straight A's if I went to his [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] school.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Besides... I'm not worried. I bet you'll like me once Viktor von Dyre launders your brain in his 're-education' spin cycle!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: That's pretty noble, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Only thing is... I'm not brainwashed. I'm helping out Viktor von Dyre because he promised I'd get straight A's if I went to his new school.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Anyway, I guess that means we `can` date, huh?
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, I guess that means we [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] date, huh?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ugh... `No...` If you're not brainwashed, you're a `criminal`, and that's even `worse...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... [color=#3b78e2][i]No...[/i][/color] If you're not brainwashed, you're a [color=#3b78e2][i]criminal[/i][/color], and that's even [color=#3b78e2][i]worse...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Besides I'm already spoken for.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Spoken for... Not spoken for...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: All I know is... You'll feel differently after Viktor von Dyre launders your brain in his 're-education' spin cycle!
Colt jams his claws into the door, makes a big circle, and shoves. A round section of door falls away...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's go get this punk!
The group scrambles through the newly-made hole and emerges on the polo field.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, we're here. Everyone spread out and search for the ancient technology.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No need...
Colt points a claw at the goal posts on the far end of the field. A guy is kneeling by one of them, fiddling with some exposed wires.
There is a spark, and the entire school lurches to the side.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Looks like our saboteur beat us here... `Hey you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like our saboteur beat us here... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hey you![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The saboteur turns back towards the group.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Uh... What are you jerks doing here? This school is private property.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You could get in a lot of trouble if you get caught.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then by all means, let's call the principal. And while we're at it, maybe you can explain why you're trying to `sink this whole island!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Then by all means, let's call the principal. And while we're at it, maybe you can explain why you're trying to [color=#e23b3b][i]sink this whole island![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chad rises, holding up his hands as if to surrender.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What are you talking about? You mean what I'm doing right now? Listen, guys, this is all just a big misunder`SAND`ing...
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you talking about? You mean what I'm doing right now? Listen, guys, this is all just a big misunder[color=#e23b3b][i]SAND[/i][/color]ing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Uh, what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Was that supposed to be some kind of joke?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Well yeah... I said `sand` instead of `stand...` And that's funny because my superpower is that I'm `made out of sand` and...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well yeah... I said [color=#e23b3b][i]sand[/i][/color] instead of [color=#e23b3b][i]stand...[/i][/color] And that's funny because my superpower is that I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]made out of sand[/i][/color] and...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh... Guess I probably should've said that part first... Maybe next time!
Chad makes a fist and punches at Howard! As it travels, Chad's fist transforms into sand and grows to enormous size!
`DNKK!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]DNKK!!![/b]

nodes.text: Howard takes a slug across the jaw and is hurled back through the air. When he lands, his body digs a mighty trench in the perfectly manicured lawn...
He doesn't get up.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: That's one down for the count! Who's next?
Sam flares up, and Chad extinguishes her blaze with a blast of sand!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? No fair!
Colt leaps forward and is immediately mired in quicksand...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, let me outta this...
Next, Chad sends out a sand blast that buries Hector and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `AHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `MEEP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]MEEP![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Last but not least, Chad turns to $SUPERZOE and grins.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Well, guess that leaves just you and me. Want to skip this whole fighting thing and go on a date together?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We'll go sunbathing at the beach. You can sunbathe...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And I'll be the beach!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `Echh...` Did you seriously just say that?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Echh...[/i][/color] Did you seriously just say that?

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE jumps back into a defensive position. She concentrates and propels a force field forward!
Chad is tossed back!
Right before he strikes the bleachers, a baseball glove made out of sand shoots up from the ground and catches him!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Playing hard to get... Me like!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Gross... Besides I would never date somebody...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text_bbcode: Him...? [color=#3b78e2][i]Why...?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam, but look around you. We're in the stables, and hay is highly flammable. You might accidentally set this whole building ablaze.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess you're right...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Plus, with those claws, Colt kind of looks like a big can opener!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's a low blow, See-Through... But not inaccurate.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `...Her?` But aren't you worried about all the hay catching on...

nodes.text: Let's find the ancient technology that keeps this island floating and make sure nobody tries to mess with it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I bet their ancient technology is hidden on the hyper polo field!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on! It's right on the other side of the stables!

nodes.text: The door's locked! We're going to have to backtrack and go around.

nodes.text: No way, Squaresville... We've already wasted enough time as it is.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're going through!

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: I don't care who, but one of you needs to stand aside...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And hurry up! I think some of the horses in here are in heat, and you know I've got animal magnetism.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Tom

nodes.text: It's a good thing I kept quiet. Tom didn't actually see me...

nodes.text: Good work, $SUPERZOE. For a second there, I thought you were going to lose it!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So you could see that Tom landed near me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not exactly... But my fire powers give me the ability to see differences in heat, and you're warmer than the ambient temperature, so... Yeah! Anyway, you did great!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay then, we all agree. The only people we know we can trust are right here.

nodes.text: Which means we need to sneak in.

nodes.text: Just one problem... How do we do that?

nodes.text: There's a gate around the entire school. There's no other way in.

nodes.text: There's a side gate, but it only opens from the inside. Which means one of us is going to have to get past Tom Prince and open it without being seen.

nodes.text: And how do you know about this gate? Did you break in to Spartan Academy before?

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.text: Well, it's the best plan we've got.

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, you can turn invisible. You're probably our best hope for getting past Tom undetected.

nodes.text: Are you up for it?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: But don't worry. I'll do my best!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Now you see me...

nodes.text: Now you don't!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.text: What...?

nodes.text: Whoa... I didn't even `think` about that...

nodes.text: Five minutes later...
$SUPERZOE and the others approach the grounds of Spartan Academy from the air.
Howard sets $SUPERZOE down gently on a patch of soft grass. Sam roughly drops Colt. Hector has transformed into a giant albatross. He unfurls a mighty claw, and Amanda jumps down.

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Can I?
Amanda levitates several inches above the ground.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oooh! I can... I forgot! `Whee!` Hector, why didn't you remind me?

nodes.speaker: Hector

Hector leans in to $SUPERZOE and whispers.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda sees faces in clouds...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If I reminded her she could fly, she'd just go up to talk to them, and then we'd lose her for hours!
Amanda looks up at the sky, and her eyes go wide!

nodes.speaker: Tom

nodes.text_bbcode: Dragon punch! Lion claw! What an otter does! [color=#e23b3b][i]...HIYAAAA!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, guys, the main entrance to Spartan Academy is right there. We could go explain ourselves to Tom Prince... Or we could sneak in...

The practice dummy superheats from the friction and turns red. Steam rises up. Colt snorts in disdain.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Stupid, Tom Prince... Doesn't even have any stupid powers... Other than being stupidly rich, I guess...
$SUPERZOE looks from Colt to Tom and then suggests...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hmm, I think we should...

nodes.text: And actually... Speaking of powers...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was thinking that when this is all over, maybe we could try something new together.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You mean, like go out on a date? Like when you flew me into the air and we kissed?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, sort of... Except without the flying.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was actually thinking we could go on a date as normal people, and we could do normal things together. As practice...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Practice doing what?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh no, that's him... That's Viktor von Dyre! Please... Somebody do something!
$SUPERZOE turns and look behind her. Howard, Sam, Colt, Hector, and Amanda are all still incapacitated...

nodes.text_bbcode: Who... Should do [color=#e23b3b][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: All of your friends have failed... As have `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: All of your friends have failed... As have [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: But do not be disappointed, my child. In fact, do not feel any emotion.

nodes.text: A few weeks later...
$SUPERZOE walks stiffly and robotically down the pristinely maintained hallways of the newly rebuilt Dyre Conservatory.
She turns, enters a classroom, and takes her assigned seat. She lays her materials in front of her in a perfectly organized row.
A moment later, Howard sits down next to her, his posture straight. He speaks flatly, with no intonation to his voice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, did you hear? Principal Dyre is assigning each student a romantic interest to go to school dances with.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He doesn't want students distracted by worrying about who they should date.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, I've been assigned to Linda, which means we're officially no longer a couple. I hope that doesn't bother you.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Nothing bothers me, Howard. I have no emotion save the desire to be the best student I can be.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Agreed.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: We have now reached our allocated quota of small talk. We should commence studying.
Around the classroom, other students nod their heads in agreement. In unison, they all up their open textbooks and begin to study...
...And study...

nodes.text: `EEP!` There's a voice in my head, and it's not one of the usual ones!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]EEP![/i][/color] There's a voice in my head, and it's not one of the usual ones!

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.text: Haha, losers... The big boss man, Viktor von Dyre, is here! Now you're really going to get it!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: And I thought I'd taught you better than to surrender. Perhaps you're not valedictorian material, after all...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What? But you said...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: `SILENCE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]SILENCE![/i][/color]

Von Dyre motions with his hand, and Howard, Sam, Colt, Amanda, and Hector are also trapped inside balls of light! They scream out, but their voices do not carry!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Howard? Sam? Are you guys...?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Don't worry, moppet. Your friends are fine. They'll be re-educated, turned into responsible members of society...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: But you... You are willfull. Stubborn. I'm not sure you `can` be rehabilitated.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you... You are willfull. Stubborn. I'm not sure you [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] be rehabilitated.

nodes.text: Von Dyre raises his hand, and an energy ball forms in his palm. The energy ball hums with terrible power.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I believe that children are our future...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: But you? ...Not so much.
Von Dyre gestures toward $SUPERZOE, and the energy ball rockets out of his palm and speeds straight towards her!
There is an explosion, a blinding flash of light, and when the light dims...
All that remains is a scorched crater and a twirling tendril of grey-black smoke! Not a trace of $SUPERZOE is left!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Yes... `Yes...` This is it! Behold the beginning of the end of The Council of Educators!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes... [color=#e23b3b][i]Yes...[/i][/color] This is it! Behold the beginning of the end of The Council of Educators!

Centerscore High was saved, but now, Monarch Prep is in trouble!
$SUPERZOE, Sam, Howard, and Colt race to the eastern shore of Centerscore Island and gaze out across the water.
In the distance, they see a second island, and on it are the magnificent towers and spires of Monarch Prep... The All-Girls Superhero School!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There it is, guys. Professor Doom said that Viktor von Dyre, the Dreadlord of Doomsday would target Monarch Prep next...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, and he'd try to `sink` it, just like he tried to sink `our` school.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and he'd try to [color=#3b78e2][i]sink[/i][/color] it, just like he tried to sink [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] school.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I know that's what he said, but... But Monarch Prep doesn't `look` like it's sinking.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know that's what he said, but... But Monarch Prep doesn't [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] like it's sinking.

nodes.text: Colt cocks an ear toward the distant island, listening.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't be so sure... Did you hear that? The tide just shifted.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You can hear the tide shift?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And smell the fish getting scared... Plus I can see `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And smell the fish getting scared... Plus I can see [color=#e23b3b][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt points at Monarch Prep. The towers and spires suddenly crumble and tumble down, as the dark waters prepare to swallow it up! The entire island sways ominously to the side!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Monarch Prep... Is sinking!
More Centerscore students race up, mouths agape and eyes wide with shock...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dang! So many girls in danger at once!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh no! This is...
A voice bursts into $SUPERZOE's brain as if through a loudspeaker. Chad doubles over, clearly hearing it too...

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: That's `Principal` von Dyre to you, whelp!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [i]Principal[/i] von Dyre to you, whelp!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yes... Yes sir...
There is a red-blue blur, and the glass cage surrounding $SUPERZOE shatters!
$SUPERZOE spins around. Sam, Colt, Hector, and Amanda have recovered and lined up in a row.
A red-blue blur, Howard zips down in the center of the group. He puts his hands on his hips triumphantly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Trapped? Not if `we` having anything to say about it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Trapped? Not if [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] having anything to say about it!
